== Usage ==
=== Unlocking More Powers ===
{{Main|Accessory Powers}}
More advanced powers can be unlocked by giving Maxwell {{Green|9x}} [[Power Stones]] of the same type.

=== Stats Tuning ===
Maxwell allows the player to tune the stats they want, so that they can optimize their setup to their liking. The stats that can be tuned are:
*{{stat|hp}}
*{{stat|def}}
*{{stat|spd}}
*{{stat|str}}
*{{stat|crit dmg}}
*{{stat|crit chance}}
*{{stat|Attack Speed}}
*{{stat|int}}

Every 10 [[Accessory Power]] grants {{yellow|1 Tuning Point}}. Tuning Points are used to tune a specific stat to increase it. The player can remove Tuning Points from stats if they want to, in case they want to invest them in another stat. The player is offered tuning templates, in which the player can save and load their stats. First template is free, the others cost {{bits|10,000}} to unlock each.
